nodes.name: FeO_x electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Fe-based nanosheets were in situ grown on Cu foam (CF) by applying a bias voltage (labelled as FeO_x). The detailed synthetic information was shown in the experimental part.
nodes.source_text: Firstly, Fe-based nanosheets were in situ grown on Cu foam (CF) by applying a bias voltage (labelled as FeO_x).

nodes.name: NiS_x electrodeposition on FeO_x
nodes.procedure: NiS_x was well-dispersed on these FeO_x nanosheets via a constant potential electrolysis method (Ni-S-FeO_x). The detailed synthetic information was shown in the experimental part.
nodes.source_text: Secondly, NiS_x was well-dispersed on these FeO_x nanosheets via a constant potential electrolysis method (Ni-S-FeO_x).

nodes.name: NiCoS_x electrodeposition on FeO_x
nodes.procedure: In the second process, Ni_yCo_{10-y}-S complex could be prepared on FeO_x by adding different molar ratios of Ni and Co (Ni_yCo_{10-y}-S-FeO_x). Specifically for Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x with optimized ratio. The detailed synthetic information was shown in the experimental part.
nodes.source_text: In the second process, Ni_yCo_{10-y}-S complex could be prepared on FeO_x by adding different molar ratios of Ni and Co (Ni_yCo_{10-y}-S-FeO_x).

nodes.description: HER performance in 1.0 M KOH at 25°C
nodes.source_text: The electrocatalytic HER activities of various samples were evaluated by using a standard three-electrode cell in 1.0 M N₂-saturated KOH. The catalysts grown on Cu foam were cut into 0.5×0.5 cm² as the working electrode. The measurement was performed at 5 mVs⁻¹ with 90% iR compensation... Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x showed a superior HER activity to achieve the high current density of 1000 mAcm⁻² with only an overpotential of 230 mV (22 mV for 10 mAcm⁻²).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x shows clear nanosheet structure with small particles too small to be clearly observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5} - S-FeO_x sample in Figure 1c showed clear nanosheet structure but the particles were too small to be clearly observed.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM identifies S-based particles around 20-30 nm in Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) image of Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5} - S - FeO_x was shown in Figure 1d to further identify the presence of S-based particles (circles, around 20 - 30 nm).

nodes.characterization_summary: Dark field EDX elemental mappings show Fe and Ni throughout Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x sample, S only in particles, weak Co signal throughout.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Dark field energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) elemental mappings for Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5} - S - FeO_x were shown in Figure 1e. Fe and Ni elements could be observed in the whole sample, while S element only existed in the particles.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows Ni_3S_2 crystal structure in particle region and Ni metal layer in nanosheet region of Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystal structure for Ni_3S_2 could be clearly observed in the particle region, while it was chiefly Ni metal layer in the nanosheet region.

nodes.characterization_summary: No obvious XRD features for Ni_yCo_{10-y}-S-FeO_x composites due to low loading content, only Cu foam peaks observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction (XRD) data of the samples were shown in Figure S3. ... no obvious features for the composites could be observed due to the low loading content of the catalysts.

nodes.characterization_summary: S K-edge XAS spectra of NiS_x, Ni-S-FeO_x and Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x similar to Ni_3S_2 reference.
nodes.evidence_snippet: S K-edge XAS spectra in Figure S4 were used to reveal the electronic structure of S-based materials. The spectra of NiS_x, Ni - S - FeO_x and Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5} - S - FeO_x were similar to that of Ni_3S_2.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS Fe 2p shows Fe^{3+} state similar to Fe_2O_3 in pure FeO_x, weak Fe-S bond peak in Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x and Ni-S-FeO_x; Ni 2p and Co 2p show multivalent states Ni^0/Ni^{2+}/Ni^{3+} and Co^0/Co^{2+}/Co^{3+} in Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x; S 2p shows metal-S bonds at 162.3 eV (2p_{3/2}) and 163.2 eV (2p_{1/2}), SO_4^{2-} signal.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure S5a exhibited the Fe 2p spectra, in which pure FeO_x was similar to Fe_2O_3 with typical Fe^{3+} state. However, for both Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5} - S - FeO_x and Ni - S - FeO_x a weak peak for Fe-S bond could be observed ... Both Ni and Co in Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5} - S - FeO_x showed multivalent states of Ni^0(Co^0) Ni^{2+}(Co^{2+}) and Ni^{3+}(Co^{3+}) ... The S 2p XPS spectra in Figure S5c revealed the existence of metal-S bonds with the peaks centered at 162.3 eV (2p_{3/2}) and 163.2 eV (2p_{1/2}).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge and Co K-edge XAS confirm Ni_3S_2 particles, Ni metal layer, Ni-S/Ni-Ni/Ni-O bonds; high valence Co^{3+} with short Co-O bond length (1.42 Å) similar to Co_2O_3 in Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x.
nodes.evidence_snippet: a high valence state of Co^{3+} similar to Co_2O_3 (a shorter bond length at 1.42Å) was created in Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5} - S - FeO_x

nodes.characterization_summary: Soft Co L-edge XAS shows dominant Co^{3+} feature (B3 peak) similar to Co_2O_3 in Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x surface region, stable after HER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x had a clear dominant B3 feature as that for Co_2O_3, standing for the presence of Co^{3+}

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Ni K-edge XAS shows no change during HER; Co K-edge shows reduced white line intensity and energy shift to lower energy under applied potential, indicating electron capture at Co sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: when a 60mV (0.06V) voltage was applied on Ni_{9.5}Co_{0.5}-S-FeO_x to drive the HER reaction ... the XAS spectrum for Co showed an obvious shift to lower energy direction
